title: DAY 7/90
SFD & BMD
scenes.voice: Day seven of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! Week two begins, and one hundred and three days are left. Today we draw beams with confidence.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Strength of Materials. Our topic: shear force and bending moment diagrams.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover cantilevers, simply supported and overhanging beams, applied couples, and beams carrying uniform and varying loads.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. The slope of the bending moment diagram equals the shear force, so the maximum bending moment occurs where shear force is zero. For a simply supported beam with U. D. L., it is w L squared by eight.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Your free practice set with step by step solutions is on Telegram now. Today's test runs seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course. Top three in the next reel.
